One room available September 1 (or sooner) in East Watertown in a sunny, spacious 4br/2ba house. Rent is $625 per month, plus utilities (electricity, gas, and wifi, totaling about $75-100 per month per person). Security deposit ($500) and last month's rent ($625) are required up front as well. You'd be signing on to the new lease from 9/1/2026-8/31/2027, but subletting has never been a problem in the past if you need more flexibility.
The apartment consists of the top two floors of a 3-story house. The available room is about 120 sq ft, plus a deep closet. It is painted a nice light grey. There is room for a full size bed, dresser, and desk, with space to move around. Dresser and desk available for free if desired. The two windows get nice light since it's on the top (3rd) floor of the house. Also on the 3rd floor is one other bedroom, the full bathroom the two rooms share, and a bonus space down the hall.
The rest of the apartment is on the 2nd floor of the house, including a fully equipped kitchen (no dishwasher, sadly), a breakfast nook/pantry, dining room, living room, screened front porch, and back porch with Boston skyline views. The other two bedrooms and the bathroom they share are also on the 2nd floor. The house is fully furnished and there is some storage space available. Washer and dryer in the basement are shared with the first-floor neighbors, and available for normal usage (i.e. weekly, not daily).
Convenient location near the Cambridge / Belmont / Watertown border. It's a 5 min. walk to either of the very frequent 71 or 73 MBTA buses. Harvard Square is under 20 min. door-to-door by bus or bike, and from Harvard you can get on the Red Line and access the rest of Cambridge, downtown Boston, and beyond. There is a driveway for free off-street tandem parking during the winter, but many/most people have happily lived here without a car. The immediate neighborhood is nice and very quiet, but anything you'd need is available within walking distance.
Looking for a non-smoking, friendly, responsible adult who unfailingly pays rent and utilities on time and doesn't require a chore chart to pick up after yourself and keep common spaces clean. This is a really great deal for the area and especially for the amount of space.
